in_sanskrit.name: Babun
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva's devotee
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Babun एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is devoted to Lord Shiva. In Hindu mythology, Shiva is the God of destruction, time, and regeneration. Devotees of Shiva are often referred to as Babas or Babas, reflecting their deep spiritual connection.
